_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Every key is optional: anything absent falls back to the defaults in vodpipe/config.py. You can also set secrets in the dashboard instead of here, or via the DEEPGRAM_API_KEY / TWITCH_OAUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variables. network.proxy is an optional HTTP/SOCKS proxy (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080) used for live capture, VOD download and live-status probes -- set it to reach Twitch and record source quality from a region it has left, such as South Korea, without a full VPN.
